title: The Singhs Hold Their Ground Against Moman Khan

blocks.text: When the charge begins, the Singhs stood in a circle with their backs towards each other so no side of the defense would collapse at once under cavalry pressure.

The attackers intended to crush the Singhs with horses’ hooves, but the resistance was so fierce that the passage got blocked with the falling bodies and the fight turned into a chaotic knot of men, animals, and steel.

Unable to break them cleanly, the Mughals fired and shot arrows from a distance until Tara Singh surged forward and caught hold of Takki Khan’s horse’s reins, drawing the clash toward single combat with the enemy leaders.
